title: Every optimization campaign comes with a second job: explaining what you did and how.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
Every optimization campaign comes with a second job: explaining what you did and how.


You finish the work, and then you have to present it. The results go to a group meeting, a project review, or whoever asked for the campaign in the first place, and turning a few hundred experiments into something a room can discuss is its own evening of work.


@ReactWise now does that part for you. When a campaign closes, we generate a presentation-ready summary: the KPIs, what was explored, what the model learned, and the operating regions rather than just the best run.


A slide showing the region around your best conditions tells the room whether there’s a robust process, not just what happened once.


Bring it to the group and spend the time discussing the chemistry instead of assembling the slides.


‍
